reason: The company is diversifying its product portfolio by entering the high-growth Tequila market through a strategic investment in Black Tiger Distilleries.
why_now: The investment was announced in a press release dated September 2, 2026.
source_headlines: Tilaknagar Industries Limited: Tilaknagar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 02, 2026, titled "Press Release pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 Tilaknagar Industries enters the Tequila market through a ₹22 Crore Strategic Investment in Black Tiger Distilleries, Maker of Bodega Suprema No. 5
